title: [BUG] API Error: Request timed out.
body: ## Environment - Platform (select one): - [X] Anthropic API - Claude CLI version: Claude Code v1.0.53 - Operating System: macOS 15.3 - Terminal: Cursor Terminal - Model (claude-sonnet-4-20250514) ## Bug Description ⎿ API Error: Request timed out. ⎿ API Error: Request timed out. ⎿ API Error (Request timed out.) · Retrying in 2 seconds… (attempt 3/10) ⎿ API Error (Request timed out.) · Retrying in 4 seconds… (attempt 4/10) ## Steps to Reproduce Some simple tasks complete ok, but anything with more than a few steps times out with the errors above. Note: claude -p "test" gives a response in under 0.5s for me here in the UK.
